posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
So unlocks, I want to think Expat's will be based on the immigrant song series, or just general mechanics, since it doesn't appear Zombie Spite is coming as well.

So my guesses:

1.  Blow up a pterodactyl with your RPG.

2.  Shoot Citizens with each type of ammo in one game.

3.  Get shot in the eye, then eat your eye, then single handedly route Lu Bu's army.  I mean the citizens of the sun, whatever.

4.  Use all 4 ammo types in a single turn.  I bet on this one.

Mister Fixer:

1.  Damage Plague rat with infection damage.

2.  Redirect Operative damage to Chairman, causing retaliation.  I hope it is this.

3.  Use all tools in one game.

4.  Use all styles in one game.

5.  Return X cards to players hands with salvage yard.

6.  Use overdrive X times in a game, or with X different tools.  I bet it is this one.

7.  Have Grease Gun destroyed by a villain.

Greatest Legacy:

1.  Same unlock for Y Legs but using her.

 

I'm actually surprised we got grandpa, it seems like they are saving the F6 promos for a group unlock, but F6 AZ would be a great release right now.  It makes him much more accessible.
